name: Just Beyond (StudioX0)
overview:
Fourteen-year-old Sora has a plan: sneak her  little brother Ren out of summer camp, catch  the last ferry at nine, and cross the bay to  reach their dad before it's too late.  A notebook. A memorized route. A loose board  in the fence. Ferry, bus, train. Simple.

But as the two of them thread through forests,  climb ridgelines, and survive one terrifyingly  close encounter with a bear — the parents  they're racing toward sit in silence across  a mediator's table. And something vast and  impossible begins to move through the clouds  above them all.

A story about a family pulling apart, two  children trying to hold it together, and the  night that changes everything.
